name.description: Name of the application database to create at first boot.

users.description: Roles created with LOGIN and granted access to the database. The first user owns it; the rest get full DDL/DML. A user with a password can authenticate over TCP (scram, incl. remote in the standalone postgres image); a user without one is local peer-auth only.

password.description: Optional password. When set, the role can authenticate over TCP via scram-sha-256.
